mods.name: Unlimited Crafting Storage Range
mods.summary: Crafting stations use the materials in every box you have placed, at any distance, not only the boxes next to them.
mods.description: Crafting stations use the items in every storage box, chest and crate you have placed, at any distance, not only the boxes right next to them. Crafting takes the materials from whichever box holds them, and from your bag if the boxes run short. No buttons. The Pokopia Editor's Unlimited Crafting Storage Range mod, made for Recompia.

mods.name: Play as Pokemon
mods.summary: Turn into any Pokémon and walk around as it; flying Pokémon can fly. Every player in a Link Play session needs it.
mods.description: Turn into Ditto or any other Pokémon and walk around as it, even one that doesn't live in your town. ZL + L3 (left stick click) turns you into the chosen Pokémon and back, ZL + D-pad Left / Right picks the previous / next Pokémon while playing, F3 or ZL + R3 opens a list of all of them. Flying Pokémon can fly: ZR takes off and rises, ZL descends and lands, ZL + ZR drops. The Pokopia Editor's Play as Pokemon mod, made for Recompia.
settings: Which list below picks the Pokémon
Flying Pokémon can fly (ZR up, ZL down, ZL + ZR drop)
ZL + D-pad Left / Right picks the previous / next Pokémon while playing
Show the Pokémon's name when transforming
Keyboard key: turn into the Pokémon (ZL + L3 does both)
Keyboard key: open the list of Pokémon (as ZL + R3)

mods.name: Simple Cheats
mods.summary: F5 adds 1,000 Life Coins, ability PP and bag stacks refill, and the Water Gun area is yours to choose. Single-player only.
mods.description: Add 1,000 Life Coins with F5, refill PP and bag stacks, and choose the Water Gun area. Single-player only.
